high_level_description: stc brand style, a family cheering while watching a screen together at an outdoor movie night on a lawn.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A grassy backyard at night, lit by a warm lantern and floor lamp beside a blank projector screen, with a woven rug and coffee table set with snacks and drinks in the foreground.

elements.desc: A man wearing a red t-shirt, seated on a wicker chair with one fist raised in celebration.
A man wearing a pink shirt, seated with a young boy on his lap, both cheering with raised fists.
A young boy wearing a blue shirt, seated on a wicker chair, clapping.
